role: AK_TEXT (lines and table rows); MODERN_EDITORIAL (the editor's numbers, brackets, note marks and folio references; his footnotes not reproduced)
comment: Frame 129, printed p. 123: the springs and rivers of the fourth clime continued: the first river concluded, between the mountain of the sun and the mountain of the Small Atlas; a river from a spring; five springs whose rivers flow into the sea; a river on an island past the town اثلا; a spring also on that island that ends in the town قا; and a spring in the mountain ٮويرٮورا, from which two rivers go out to two small lakes. The editor's running numbers (١٨٥٤)-(١٨٧٤) and the numbers of Suhrāb [١٨٥٩]-[١٨٧٨] and [١٨٨٠]; a word supplied by the editor between angle brackets. Three lines of the editor's footnotes.

observations: The river goes on from p. 122 (frame 128), whose last words, «نهر اوّله عين عند», L01 continues with «طول ٮا {z} والعرض لا ل (١٨٥٤)», a river whose beginning is a spring at the longitude ٮا ō and the latitude 31° 30′; «يمرّ فيما بين جبل الشمس وجبل اطلس الصغير مصبّه فى البحر عند طول ح ك والعرض لب {z} (١٨٥٥) *» (L01-L02), it passes between the mountain of the sun and the mountain of the Small Atlas, and its mouth in the sea is at the longitude 8° 20′ and the latitude 32° 0′. The mountains are entries 729-730, «جبل الشمس الثانى», the second mountain of the sun, and 731-732, «جبل اطلس الصغير», of the table of the mountains (frame 056, L07, L08).

L02-L04: «نهر اوّله عين عند طول ٮا يه والعرض لا ل (١٨٥٦)», a river whose beginning is a spring at the longitude ٮا يه and the latitude 31° 30′; «ومصبّه فى البحر عند طول ٮٮ {z} والعرض لح ل (١٨٥٧) *», and its mouth in the sea is at the longitude ٮٮ ō and the latitude 38° 30′.

L04-L05: «عين اوّلها عند طول ٮح ى والعرض لا ن (١٨٥٨) ومصبّها فى البحر عند طول ٮح ل والعرض لح {z} (١٨٥٩) *», a spring whose beginning is at the longitude ٮح ى and the latitude 31° 50′, and its mouth in the sea is at the longitude ٮح ل and the latitude 38° 0′. L05-L07: «عين اوّلها عند طول ٮد ى والعرض لا {z} (١٨٦٠) ومصبّها فى البحر عند طول ٮد ى والعرض لٮ ل (١٨٦١) *», a spring at the longitude ٮد ى and the latitude 31° 0′, with its mouth in the sea at the longitude ٮد ى and the latitude لٮ ل. L07-L08: «عين اوّلها عند طول ٮد م والعرض لا {z} (١٨٦٢) مصبّها فى البحر عند طول ٮد م والعرض لٮ ك (١٨٦٣) *», a spring at the longitude ٮد م and the latitude 31° 0′, its mouth in the sea at the longitude ٮد م and the latitude لٮ ك.

L09-L10: «عين اوّلها عند طول ٮح ن والعرض ل ل (١٨٦٤) مصبّها فى البحر عند طول ٮح مه والعرض لب ⟨{z}⟩ (١٨٦٥) *», a spring at the longitude ٮح ن and the latitude 30° 30′, its mouth in the sea at the longitude ٮح مه and the latitude 32° ⟨0′⟩. L10-L11: «عين اوّلها عند طول ٮط ى والعرض لا {z} (١٨٦٦) مصبّها فى البحر عند طول ٮط كه والعرض لٮ {z} (١٨٦٧) *», a spring at the longitude ٮط ى and the latitude 31° 0′, its mouth in the sea at the longitude ٮط كه and the latitude لٮ ō.

L12-L14: «نهر فى جزيرة اوّله عند طول ل {z} والعرض له {z} (١٨٦٨)», a river on an island; its beginning is at the longitude 30° 0′ and the latitude 35° 0′; «يمرّ الى عرض لو {z} على سمت الطول (١٨٦٩)», it passes to the latitude 36° 0′ along the line of the same longitude, point 1869 given by its latitude only; «ويعدل الى وسط مدينة اثلا ويصبّ فى البحر عند طول كح ك والعرض له م (١٨٧٠) *», and it turns to the middle of the town اثلا and flows into the sea at the longitude 28° 20′ and the latitude 35° 40′. The town is entry 206 of the table of the cities (frame 022, L11), «مدينة اٮلا فى جزيرة», at the longitude كح ل and the latitude له ل, where the editor's note a gives the form of this entry (1870), اثلا; here the ث has its three dots.

L14-L16: «عين فى هٰذه الجزيرة ايضاً عند طول ل م والعرض له ل (١٨٧١)», a spring also on this island, at the longitude 30° 40′ and the latitude 35° 30′; «ومنتهاها فى مدينة قا عند طول لا مه والعرض له م (١٨٧٢) *», and its end is in the town قا, at the longitude 31° 45′ and the latitude 35° 40′. The town is entry 210 of the table of the cities (frame 022, L15), «مدينة قا فى جزيرة», at the longitude لٮ ō and the latitude لد ن.

L16-L18: «عين فى جبل ٮويرٮورا يخرج منها نهران الى بطيحتين صغيرتين اوّلهما عند طول لج ن والعرض ل {z} (١٨٧٣)», a spring in the mountain ٮويرٮورا, from which two rivers go out to two small lakes; their beginning is at the longitude 33° 50′ and the latitude 30° 0′; «احدى البطيحتين عند طول له {z} والعرض لا {z} (١٨٧٤)», one of the two lakes is at the longitude 35° 0′ and the latitude 31° 0′; «والثانية عند طول», and the second at the longitude …, continued on p. 124.

L16: «ٮويرٮورا»: a tooth without a dot joined to a و; a tooth with the two dots of the ي below it joined to a ر; a tooth without a dot joined to a second و; then a ر and the final alif. Transcribed as printed. The name does not stand in the table of the mountains of the fourth clime read so far (frames 056-060), and the editor gives no note on it.

Without their dots, transcribed so: a tooth without its dot in the degrees of the longitude, which read with a ي gives: «ٮا» (L01, L03), the tooth joined to an alif, 11, where the minutes «يه» of L03 have the two dots of the ي; «ٮح» (L04, L05, L09, L10), 18; «ٮد» (L06, L07, L08), 14; «ٮط» (L10, L11), 19. «ٮٮ» (L03), a tooth joined to a final ب, both without dots, 62 px wide, which read with a ي give 12, beside the beginning of the river at «ٮا يه», 11° 15′ read with a ي; «لٮ» (L07, L08, L11), the ل joined to the flat bowl of a final ب without its dot, 32, where L02 and L10 print «لب» with the dot.

The ح of the numerals, «ح» (L02), «لح» (L04, L05), «ٮح» (L04, L05, L09, L10) and «كح» (L14), shows no dot in the bowl; the ج of «لج» (L17) has its dot, 5 by 6 px. The isolated ك, 20, is printed with the small inner stroke of the letter (L02, L08, L14); the isolated ى, 10, has no dots (L04, L06, L07, L10).

L10: a short horizontal stroke, 19 by 6 px, stands 15 px above the head of the ح of «ٮح مه», under the line over the numerals; it is not a dot of the font, which are round, some 9 by 9 px, and is not transcribed.
L10: the editor supplies the minutes of the latitude, «⟨{z}⟩», between angle brackets within the line over the numerals, followed by the note mark b. Transcribed with the brackets.

Signs in the text, transcribed as printed: «يمرّ» (L01, L13) with a shadda over the ر; «اوّله» (L02, L12), «اوّلها» (L04, L06, L07, L09, L10) and «اوّلهما» (L17) with a shadda over the و; «مصبّه» (L02), «ومصبّه» (L03), «ومصبّها» (L05, L06), «مصبّها» (L08, L09, L11) and «ويصبّ» (L14) with a shadda over the ب; «هٰذه» (L14) with a dagger alif above the ه; «ايضاً» (L15) with the tanwin of the accusative over its alif; «فى», «الى» and «احدى» end in a ى without dots. «مصبّه» (L02) and «مصبّها» (L08, L09, L11) stand without the و that «ومصبّه» (L03) and «ومصبّها» (L05, L06) have.

The running numbers run (١٨٥٤)-(١٨٧٤) without a gap, and each has a number of Suhrāb: [١٨٥٩]-[١٨٧٧] after (١٨٥٤)-(١٨٧٢), then [١٨٨٠] after (١٨٧٣) and [١٨٧٨] after (١٨٧٤); [١٨٧٩] does not occur on this page. [١٨٦٣] stands at the beginning of L05, after the running number (١٨٥٨) at the end of L04, and [١٨٧٢] at the beginning of L12, after (١٨٦٧) at the end of L11.

Asterisks: the small open stars with six points, after [١٨٦٠] (L02), [١٨٦٢] (L04), [١٨٦٤] (L05), [١٨٦٦] (L07), [١٨٦٨] (L08), [١٨٧٠] (L10), [١٨٧٢] (L12), [١٨٧٥] (L14) and [١٨٧٧] (L16), are transcribed as asterisks.
Note marks: L07, a after the latitude; L10, b after the closing bracket; L13, c after the latitude; L15, d after «ايضاً»; L17, e after «اوّلهما» and f after «احدى».

Note c prints «لر {z}»: the letter joined to the foot of the ل has the small pointed head of the ر, 7 px from the stem, where the text prints «لو {z}» (L13) with the round loop of the و, 13 px; in these numerals the editor reads ر as ز (introduction, frame 196, p. XVII), so 37° 0′ against 36° 0′. Note a prints «لٮ {z}», without the dot of the ب.
The editor's footnotes stand in three lines below a short rule at the left: notes a-f. The page number «— ١٢٣ —» stands at the foot, centred.
